southern_pine.note: NDS Table 4B values are tabulated per nominal width — the size factor CF is ALREADY incorporated in these values (size_factor_applied = true), unlike Table 4A. Do not apply CF again.

size_factors_CF._missing_reason: The repo carries NO NDS Table 4A size-factor (CF) matrix as a dataset. Table 4A's seed (wood_sawn_reference_design_values_nds2024_table_4a.json) stores only a boolean 'size_factor_applied': false per record and has no adjustment-factor block in its metadata; the member_db migrations only define a size_factor_applied INTEGER column (0002/0008/0010/0014) and carry no CF values; no file in the repo exposes a CF table keyed by grade category and depth. The only CF numbers present anywhere are the per-record 'size_factor_for_cm_threshold' blocks in the phase-1 seed, which the seed itself flags as 'size_factor_used_for_cm_threshold_only': true — they exist solely to test the NDS wet-service Cm thresholds (Fb*CF <= 1150 psi, Fc*CF <= 750 psi), not as a published adjustment table. Those values are reproduced verbatim under 'partial_from_repo' and cover only depths 2x4/2x6/2x8/2x10/2x12 for the visually graded grades in that seed. NOT present in the repo and therefore NOT supplied: the 2x5 column, the 14"-and-wider column, and the Construction / Standard / Utility grade-category rows. No remembered values were substituted.

partial_from_repo.caveat: Verbatim from the seed, no interpretation applied. Note that the seed's Stud-grade entries for 2x8/2x10/2x12 equal its SS/No.1/No.2/No.3 entries (1.2/1.1/1.0), i.e. the seed reuses the No.3 column for Stud at those depths. Published NDS Table 4A tabulates Stud CF only through 2x6; treat the wider-Stud entries as the seed's own Cm-threshold convention, not as a citable published CF.
